steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We've arrived at Magnethill No. 2. Repeat, we've arrived at Magnethill No. 2.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Iana, Ela, report the situation on your end, over.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Business as usual. Just putting in the finishing touches.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: If the intel we got is correct, this should be the last batch!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We'll head towards you after we clean up over here!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Just sit back and leave it to the Poles.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I already hear the sound of Grzmot mines going off. They'll be just fine.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: And you, Blitz, you're supposed to be doing your job. Namely, standing guard.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Pay attention to the meter's readout. The intel shows that there's nuclear waste sealed inside this building.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Frost, how far until our objective?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: After we pass through the checkpoint and the storage room, the main laboratory should be right there.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The drones showed that the mercenaries set up some simple fortifications at and around the checkpoint.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: No bunkers, no dead ends. The entrance has been sealed shut, and they've laid a lot of barbed wire all around.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Nine. Their rough positions have been marked on the team terminal.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The entrance of the long corridor leading from the checkpoint into the storage room has been completely sealed, and the drones haven't been able to get in any farther.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Okay, I'll take care of this.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Do you have any suggestions, Lord?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I still have some extra incendiary rounds. How many do you need?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The checkpoint entrance's full of obstacles. Blow it up, and the rubble's just going to be in the way.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Here's the plan. We'll blast the ceiling and the wall on the right. One of us will rappel in from the top and provide cover fire. The rest of us will breach from the right side.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Frost, you're on cover fire and support.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Once the charges go off, Tachanka, drop a grenade from up top. The rest of us will throw flashbangs at the designated locations.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: On the ground, we'll head inside in this order: Blitz, Ash, Tachanka. Look alive out there. Don't let this opportunity slip away.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If you have any questions, it's now or never.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You all ready? Good. Take position.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Frost, on your mark, that's when we'll begin.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'll provide cover fire. The rest of you, move up!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Blitz, stay alert. Tachanka, use the drone and check out the hallway and the storage room's status.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How is it looking up ahead?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The storage room was filled with ammo and supplies. They had been stationed here for some time.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: There are no hostiles in the storage room. Just black crystals on some petri dishes.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What's this stuff inside the cans?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Glowing mineral crystals. Never seen them before.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Minerals. Composites. As long as they are glowing, they might be radioactive.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Don't worry. Geiger's not reacting to anything.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Then let's leave them be and go straight in.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Time's a wasting, team. Let's move.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We have just taken care of the enemy, but they have blocked the corridor passage with a lot of obstacles.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We have to take a different route to the core, over.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We're about to head inside the main laboratory. I need you to come back us up ASAP, over.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What now? Shall we wait for them?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No, time is pressing. Keep going.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Up ahead is the main laboratory.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Stay alert. Subdue the target when you have them in sight.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: There's no one here, just these strange machines.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't let your guard down. The lab equipment's running, which means the target is still here.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Then we need to head inside the real laboratory.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This here is the control room. You see the machines on the other side of that window? That's where the actual experiments happen.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Stay alert... We don't know how many hostiles we have here.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I see unwelcome friends will always invite themselves in.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Looks like we're the only ones here.)

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Put your hands up, Dr. Levi. Move away from the terminal.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: And here I was wondering how much longer it would take you to show up.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Did you take out my security detail? What a shame.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I cut them their last paycheck just yesterday.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Well, I ask you to be careful with the things here. They can be delicate.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't even try to do anything funny. This charade is over.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Over? My new experiment has just started.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Stop what you're doing... This is your last warning.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Hahahahaha, and what if I refuse?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: What's the matter? Are you afraid of a senile, defenseless ordinary citizen?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You are the chief scientist of the Magnethill No. 2 laboratory, Levi Klitschko.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Stay away from the equipment. I know exactly what you're trying to do.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I've got to hand it to you. Your team works fast.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: There's nothing you can do to stop it, but do feel free to fire your weapons.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: If it wasn't for those shortsighted, useless morons getting in my way again and again...

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I would've finished all of this twenty years ago.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You have no idea what you are doing.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The equipment in this lab is in disrepair, and you are creating a nuclear contamination disaster!

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Of course I know what I am doing.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: The road of exploratory science is a treacherous one.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Yet it's a road worth taking. Roads that lead to the truth are always worth taking.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: All I am doing now is getting the results I should've had twenty years ago, and no one has the right to stop me.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Uh, just complaining a little bit about the close miss just now.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We could've regrouped with the rest of the team at the main lab!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, it's coming from the lab!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Get your Replicator ready. They might be in trouble.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Wh-What the hell's this? ! Where's everyone?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Where's the map? What's with this huge hole?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: There's no problem with the map. The main lab should be behind this door.
I'm just giving her pressure points a few presses to help patch her up.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: ...After that madman activated his equipment, the whole lab was swept by a huge shockwave.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The target activated that weird device of his, and we all got knocked out by the blast.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: And after we came around, well, this is it.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: We don't have any signal, so we can't contact Ela and Iana.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The only thing I am sure about is we definitely aren't anywhere near the mission area.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: It's hardly the most precise way to put it, but it's like we were... teleported... somewhere with the whole lab.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: She's right. It's like we were suddenly launched by a rocket to the moon and that's not a joke.

a.text: Through a huge crack in the wall, all one can see outside the house is a desolate desert. As if the house had fallen from the sky to the desert.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If Levi Klitschko was swept by the shockwave too, he'd probably be in a similar situation.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We'll rest up first. I'll plan our next steps.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Good news first. The supplies for those mercenaries have been thrown in with us, so at least for a short time ammo won't be an issue.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Eyes open! There's something outside coming toward us!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It sounds like some sort of heavy machinery... but it's way too fast!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: *Profanity* We're in big trouble! Prepare for battle!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Have you ever seen an arthropod as big as a small car?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Normal bullets aren't going to penetrate its husk!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: If we let that thing tear the control room's wall down, it's all over for us! !

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: But shooting its legs isn't stopping it!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let it bring the wall down!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm fine. It's just my shield's busted.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It took a good bite out of the wall.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Let's be sure to take its husk down when we get our payback.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'm not sure we can call it a plan, but it's the only choice we have.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Your ammo is the only thing we have that's doing any damage to that thing. Plus my breaching rounds, maybe.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We'll take him down the moment he breaches the wall.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Judging by the damage AP's done on that thing, the breaching round should take its leg down. Hopefully that'll give us a clean view of its underside.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: After that, it's going to be all you.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If any of you has a better idea, I'm all ears.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Ahh, finally time to take a breather.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Like, you know, the planet we all know about?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But we need to prepare for the worst.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: With the wall collapsed, we can't even use this place as shelter.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's get moving. At least until we find another place to hunker down.
